treatment.name: Teeth Whitening
treatment.overview: Professional whitening safely lightens tooth shade by removing stains from enamel and dentin.

types.name: In-Office Whitening
description: Fast, visible results in a single visit.

cost.note: Depends on starting shade, stains, and method chosen.

before: Oral exam; cleaning may be advised.

avoid: Strong chromogenic foods/drinks for 48 hours (tea, coffee, wine, beetroot)
prefer: 'White diet': milk, rice, bananas, plain yogurt
foodGuidelines.tip: Use sensitivity toothpaste before/after treatment if prone to sensitivity.

prosConsOfSkipping.summary: Whitening is a safe, quick boost to smile aesthetics when professionally supervised.

faq.a: Yes—professional whitening is safe when dentist-supervised.
3-6 months depending on diet and habits; touch-ups help maintain shade.
